name: palm
description: A coconut-style palm: a slim, gently leaning trunk ringed with leaf scars and swollen at the foot, a crown shaft with a cluster of coconuts, and a ring of long, arching feather fronds whose leaflets hang down on both sides of the midrib; every frond is its own node with its pivot at the crown, so it can sway.

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the trunk top in metres.
